description: One line of app.log. The file is JSONL: one record per line, never pretty-printed.

code.description: Catalog code. Every possible value is in log-catalog.json.

durMs.description: Duration of the operation, on its closing record.

errKind.description: Machine-readable error family, so failures group without parsing msg.

fields.description: Typed payload declared by the code. `_defects` lists validation failures, `_truncatedFields` counts values dropped or marked to fit the size budget.

level.description: Severity. May be raised above the catalog default by the call site.

msg.description: Human sentence. Never parse this: parse fields.

opId.description: One per user-visible operation. Shared by every record of that attempt.

outcome.description: How an operation ended. Absent on records that do not close one.

runId.description: One per process launch. Scopes everything to a single session.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this record shape. Version 1 is the legacy line: {tsMs, level, source, message, details}, no code and no fields.

source.description: Dotted module the record came from, e.g. platform.steam. Drives the per-module level filter.

tsMs.description: Unix milliseconds when the record was built.

title: accshift log record
